experience.sameEvent: One X-ray event. Two paths to a signal.
experience.qualitative: Conceptual illustration, not to scale. Profiles use the same horizontal scale and equal peak height; they are not measured performance. Direct conversion can still spread charge and incur losses.
experience.indirectSub: X-rays become light in the scintillator. Light spreads before the photodiode converts it into charge, producing a wider readout signal.
experience.directSub: X-rays become electrical charge in the CdTe or silicon layer. Charge is collected locally by the readout, without a scintillator light-spread stage.
